headline: Linn Mercy Flags Shift Sharply as Callums Cape Bleeds On
war_summary: Since the last edition the flags have shifted sharply at Linn Mercy, where the Warden count has fallen from three posts to one—nine now fly Colonial colours and one lies in ruin—with losses still falling heaviest on the Warden side even as the pace cools. Weathered Expanse remains the sternest exchange, its latest flag movement logged at the filing hour; Wardens hold five posts to two Colonial, two demolished, one fewer Warden post than at the previous filing. Callums Cape, the day's bloodiest field with some 3,500 casualties in two hours and 48 flag events in twenty-four, now stands four Colonial posts to three Warden against the even split last recorded, though the hourly toll eases from its peak. At Mooring County one Warden post has gone over, the count standing nine to three, and Colonial losses there accelerate. Stlican Shelf's fighting quickens sharply about Briar, Warden casualties climbing, while Marban Hollow has fallen quiet since evening. Nevish Line, Godcrofts and Stonecradle show no flag movement for hours. Across the map more than four of every five strategic posts fly Colonial colours. It is the 799th day; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
